title: File:Mohamed Eslami (2021).jpg
desc:
HE Mr. Mohamed Eslami, Vice President of the Islamic Republic of Iran and Chief of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI), delivers his statement at the 65th Regular Session of the IAEA General Conference. IAEA, Vienna, Austria, 20 September 2021
Photo Credit: Dean Calma / IAEA

title: File:Mohammad Eslami, Head of the Atomic Energy Organization, visits the editorial office of Avash 3 Avash.webp
desc: Translation of original description: Mohammad Eslami, the head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran, on Wednesday afternoon, January 28, 2026, while attending and visiting Avash Media, answered questions from Avash reporter about the nuclear issues of the Islamic Republic of Iran.
